newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemalan ambassador among hostages in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Guatemalan ambassador among hostages in Peru.

text.p: Guatemala's ambassador to Peru is among hostages being held by armed guerrillas at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, Guatemala's foreign minister said on Wednesday.
Foreign Minister Eduardo Stein told reporters that Guatemalan ambassador Jose Maria Argueta had not been harmed.
"The information that we have is that he and all the hostages are in perfect shape," Stein said.
Guerrillas of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement took over the residence Tuesday night, demanding that jailed members of their group be freed.
